d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how Turkey and Qatar have officially signed a mutual defence agreement in Istanbul, pledging a unified stance against any external armed attack targeting either nation. Announced following high-level talks between Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan and Qatari Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, the pact deepens collective security, joint military exercises, personnel training, and defence-industry collaboration.
